localizedValues.name: S1-Upper Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
The upper picnic area kitchen shelter will accommodate up to 100 people max. Water and electricity are on site. Water is shut off for winterization from October through March.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: S2-Doetsch Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
The Doetsch Picnic Shelter can hold up to 100 people. Water and electricity are on site. Water is shut off for winterization from October through March.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
Group camp is for tent and/or RV use. This is dry camping. No hookups. The camp accommodates 50 people. Facilities include one kitchen shelter with water and power, a picnic shelter without water or power, two adirondack (three-sided) sleeping shelters, and two vault toilets. Showers are available at the Moorage Area or the main campground.
Group camp G1 is adjacent to a residential neighborhood. Please be respectful of neighboring property owners. Amplified music is not permitted.
